description: This file contains extension methods for IOrchardHelper related to content item retrieval and querying, marked as obsolete.

classes.name: ContentRazorHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IOrchardHelper to retrieve content items, marked as obsolete.

methods.name: GetContentItemIdByHandleAsync
methods.description: Returns a content item id by its handle asynchronously.

methods.name: GetContentItemByHandleAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item by its handle asynchronously.

methods.name: GetContentItemByIdAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item by its id asynchronously.

methods.name: GetContentItemsByIdAsync
methods.description: Loads multiple content items by their ids asynchronously.

methods.name: GetContentItemByVersionIdAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item by its version id asynchronously.

methods.name: QueryContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Queries content items based on a provided query function asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRecentContentItemsByContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves recent content items of a specific type asynchronously.
